engine: AIR T-430 investment advantage card (desktop): at rest the dark card is SILENT (small index top-left + a short uppercase title pressed to the bottom edge); on hover the title rides UP and the full text unfolds beneath it (clip-path inset top-down + opacity) with a hairline rule drawing itself scaleX 0->1. The card NEVER changes size, so the grid stays frozen and the opened card overlaps zero neighbours (C28). Keyboard focus reveals exactly like hover (a11y); closing waits until the card is neither hovered nor focused. T-M18 mobile (<=768px, from the REAL AIR phone recording, /investment f169-180): the hover reveal is KILLED - the cards become a HORIZONTAL SCROLL-SNAP strip of frosted-glass cards over a dark architectural macro photo (the photo is host markup behind the track); title on top, FULL text visible IMMEDIATELY at the bottom, the neighbour card peeking past the edge as the swipe cue. No hover, no tap-to-reveal - swipe replaces hover. backdrop-filter over a STATIC photo is the registry-sanctioned D2 exception. Without JS / under reduced-motion the card is the STATIC TRUTH: full text visible in normal flow (CSS default without .icr-wired).

measured_teardown.move: markup-first: [data-icr-card] with [data-icr-title] + [data-icr-body]; the component injects the .icr-rule hairline as the body's first child. DESKTOP: cards get .icr-wired (absolute layout: title bottom-anchored, body hidden underneath); after fonts.ready, measure() reads each body's bbox height once (never per frame, D6) -> lift = bodyH + gapPx; open = title translateY(-lift) + body clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) -> inset(0 0 0% 0) + opacity 0->1 + rule scaleX 0->1 on the inlined house ease (D13); close = the same three properties back; GSAP drives ONLY transform / opacity / clip-path (D4), zero CSS transitions on those props (D3). MOBILE (T-M18): the host gets .icr-swipe (flex + overflow-x auto + scroll-snap-type x mandatory + -webkit-overflow-scrolling touch), each card gets .icr-frost (rgba glass + backdrop blur), text open from the first paint, zero listeners, zero GSAP - the strip is native snap scroll.
measured_teardown.cited: AIR /investment desktop: dark advantage cards (HIGH DEMAND / STRONG TENANT BASE / TENANTS CORE) revealing their full text on hover - the section Yehor named his favourite: laconic, restrained, deep. AIR mobile teardown (D_AIR_mobile_video f169-180): 5 advantage cards = frosted swipe strip, title on top, full text visible at once, hover reveal dead; same mechanic as the district-numbers strip (f61-72). Registry row T-M18 marks this the canonical mobile translation of both T-430 and T-422.

mode.what: 'auto' = matchMedia picks the branch and rebuilds on breakpoint crossing; 'desktop' / 'mobile' force a branch (the lab relies on 'auto' at 390x844 to probe the T-M18 strip).

mobileBreakpoint.what: max-width at/below which the T-M18 frosted-swipe strip replaces the hover grid; in the mobile branch no hover/tap reveal listeners exist at all.

duration.what: desktop reveal duration. Close runs slightly faster (x0.8 on the body) so the card returns to silence crisply.

ease.what: named house token ('air' = cubic-bezier(.25,.74,.22,.99), 'out-quad', 'out-expo') applied to all three reveal properties; inlined bezier solver (D13: no gsap.utils.parseEase).

gapPx.what: air between the lifted title and the revealed body (desktop). lift = measured body height + this gap; re-measured on resize (debounced), never in the frame.

css_surface.--icr-bg: card background (default #141210 - the dark advantage card, desktop)
css_surface.--icr-radius: card corner radius (default 22px = house radius token; C12 - no naked squares)
css_surface.--icr-min-h: desktop card min-height (default clamp(260px, 24vw, 380px)) - fixed size is what buys the frozen grid / zero-overlap law
css_surface.--icr-card-w: T-M18 card width in the strip (default 78% of the track - the neighbour peek IS this knob)
css_surface.--icr-frost-blur: T-M18 backdrop blur radius (default 14px; legal ONLY over a static photo per the T-M18 registry row / D2 exception)

entry: InvestCardReveal.create(target, opts) -> { cards, mode, track, open(i), close(i), toggle(i), isOpen(i), measure(), refresh(), destroy(), ready }. target = a container holding [data-icr-card] children (or a single card element). ready = a Promise resolving after fonts.ready + measure (desktop) or after the strip is built (mobile). cards[i].lift exposes the measured travel for machine probes; track returns the snap-strip element in the mobile branch (else null). open/close/toggle are desktop-only (the strip text is always open).
law: transform / opacity / clip-path ONLY (D4); zero CSS transition on GSAP-driven props (D3); geometry read in measure() after fonts.ready, never per frame (D6); the desktop card never changes size on reveal -> grid frozen, bbox intersection with siblings = 0, probed on the MIDDLE card of the row (C28); no mix-blend, no WebGL; backdrop-filter ONLY in the T-M18 strip over a static host photo (registry-sanctioned D2 exception; the dark layer on top of the photo is a denser tint, never a blend); overflow clip, never overflow-x hidden (K1.7) - the strip itself is overflow-x auto BY DESIGN and the page must never gain a horizontal scrollbar from it; a11y: desktop tabindex + aria-expanded + aria-hidden, focus reveals like hover, close only when neither hovered nor focused; mobile = no hover dependence at all (T-M18: text open, swipe is navigation not disclosure); no-JS / reduced-motion = static truth with the full text visible; the component NEVER sets __LAB_OK__ - the lab owns the gate (B14/B15).
gate_mode: driven interaction (B14). DESKTOP: the lab DISPATCHES the events and samples values over time - mouseenter on the MIDDLE card, body opacity sampled at 120/300/800ms (monotonic rise, NOT yet settled at 120ms), settled at >= 0.99 with the clip open and the title lifted by exactly the measured lift (+-3px); zero bbox overlap with both neighbours and the body fully inside the card (C28); mouseleave returns the card to silence; card.focus() opens and blur() closes (keyboard pack); closed truth asserted on ALL cards before any drive. MOBILE (<=768px, T-M18 pack): mode === 'mobile' + .icr-swipe built; every card's text open immediately (no hover, no tap); the track overflows AND actually swipes (scrollLeft driven to 200 -> really moved); snap exists (scroll-snap-type contains x, every card scroll-snap-align != none); neighbour peek (card width <= 90% of track); no card text cut (title+body Range-rects fully inside their card bbox); horizontal scroll ONLY inside the track (documentElement/body without x-overflow); frosted glass (computed backdrop-filter has blur) over a really loaded macro photo; page <= 7 screens, no content gap > 1.5 screens, text Range-rects at left >= 16px.
proven: lab.html v2: 4 honest-register cards (ET-29 canon lines: Статус / Двір / Рендери / Дати) between two full-bleed render sections (C11, renders/ symlink); on mobile the strip rides over renders/macro-roof.webp (dark architectural macro) under a dense tint. Headless-measured at 1440x900: closed truth on all 4 cards; middle-card drive opacity 0.315 -> 0.892 -> 1.0 at 120/300/800ms, title lifted 78px = measured lift 78px exactly, body inside card, neighbour bbox overlap 0 px2, mouseleave re-closes, focus opens / blur closes, 0 console errors. T-M18 pack at 390x844: strip built, text open on every card, driven scrollLeft 200 -> actually moved 191px, snap 'x mandatory' on every card, card = 31% of the track (both neighbours peek), no text cut, page free of x-overflow, frost blur(14px) over the loaded macro, page 2.31 screens, max gap 0.12 screens, min text-rect left 23.4px. Both packs also green at 1280x720. __LAB_OK__ only after all probes + zero console errors.
